description: This PHP source file defines an abstract REST controller class in the OrangeHRM system, providing the core logic for handling REST API requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). It manages request initialization, validation, routing to specific request handlers, and error handling with detailed exception management. It also includes traits for logging and internationalization support.

classes.name: AbstractRestController
classes.description: An abstract base class that provides standardized handling of REST API requests, including validation, request dispatching, and error management for derived controllers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the request; meant to be overridden in subclasses.

methods.description: Abstract method for handling GET requests.

methods.description: Abstract method for handling POST requests.

methods.description: Abstract method for handling DELETE requests.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Determines and retrieves the appropriate validation rules based on the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for processing an HTTP request; dispatches to specific handler methods and manages exceptions.
